description: Create a recurring calendar event with configurable recurrence rules.

organizer_id.description: User ID of the event organizer

start_datetime.description: ISO8601 datetime for the first occurrence

duration_minutes.description: Duration of each occurrence in minutes; must be positive

frequency.description: Recurrence frequency: daily, weekly, or monthly

interval.description: Interval between occurrences; must be positive

end_type.description: How the recurrence ends: count, date, or never

count.description: Number of occurrences; required when end_type is count

end_date.description: ISO8601 date after which no more occurrences are created; required when end_type is date

attendees.description: Optional list of attendee email addresses
